domains.title: Apache Kafka Fundamentals
domains.summary: Topics, partitions, offsets and ordering; keys and key hashing; records and headers; replication and retention; topic configuration and data modelling; the command-line tools.

domains.title: Application Development
domains.summary: Producing and consuming, client tuning and compression, error handling, delivery semantics and transactions, serialization and Schema Registry, connecting to a secured cluster, the Admin API and deploying clients.

domains.title: Kafka Streams
domains.summary: Writing Streams applications: KStream, KTable and GlobalKTable, repartitioning, joins and windows, state stores and exactly-once.

domains.title: Kafka Connect
domains.summary: Source and sink connectors, change data capture, standalone vs distributed workers, converters and SMTs, error handling and the REST API. Settings of specific connectors are out of scope.

domains.title: Application Testing
domains.summary: Unit tests with MockProducer, MockConsumer and TopologyTestDriver, and integration tests against a real broker.

domains.title: Application Observability
domains.summary: Client metrics and consumer lag, and diagnosing common client errors and symptoms.

topics.title: Partitions, keys and ordering
topics.summary: Keyed hashing, the sticky behaviour for null keys, custom partitioners, what preserves and breaks per-key order, and callbacks vs future.get().
blueprint: Understand Apache Kafka core concepts including partitions, topics, and ordering

topics.title: Records, offsets and headers
topics.summary: What a record carries (key, value, timestamp, headers), offsets as positions within a partition, CreateTime vs LogAppendTime, and using headers for metadata.

topics.title: Topic design and data modelling
topics.summary: Choosing a partition count, what adding partitions does to keyed data, message keys, and topic-level overrides.

topics.title: Replication, ISR and leader election
topics.summary: Replication factor, the in-sync replica set, high watermark, leader election and unclean election, and KRaft controllers.
topics.badgeNote: Kafka 4.x is KRaft-only. Any ZooKeeper question is legacy and badged Unsure.

topics.title: Segments, retention and compaction
topics.summary: Log segments, time and size retention, cleanup.policy delete vs compact, tombstones and the compaction lag settings.

topics.title: The Kafka CLI tools
topics.summary: kafka-topics, the console producer and consumer, and kafka-consumer-groups including --reset-offsets.
blueprint: Work with Apache Kafka from the command line

topics.title: acks and min.insync.replicas
topics.summary: What acks=0/1/all promise, how min.insync.replicas turns acks=all into a durability guarantee, and the errors you get when it can't be met.

topics.title: Idempotence, retries and timeouts
topics.summary: The idempotent producer and its constraints, how retries are bounded by delivery.timeout.ms, and retriable vs non-retriable errors.
blueprint: Implement processing semantics such as exactly once / at least once

topics.title: Batching, compression and buffering
topics.summary: How batch.size and linger.ms trade latency for throughput, where compression happens, and what blocks send() when the buffer fills.
blueprint: Client configuration and tuning (batching and parallelism)

topics.title: Consumer groups and rebalancing
topics.summary: Partition assignment, idle consumers, eager vs cooperative rebalancing, static membership, and the new group protocol in Kafka 4.x.
topics.badgeNote: The KIP-848 consumer protocol is new in 4.x; how much the exam asks about it is a guess (Likely).
blueprint: Client configuration and tuning (batching and parallelism)

topics.title: Offsets, commits and lag
topics.summary: auto.offset.reset, auto-commit timing, commitSync vs commitAsync, seeking, and what consumer lag measures.
blueprint: Implement processing semantics such as exactly once / at least once

topics.title: The poll loop, liveness and fetching
topics.summary: max.poll.interval.ms vs session.timeout.ms, heartbeats, max.poll.records, and how fetch.min.bytes and fetch.max.wait.ms shape fetches.

topics.title: Delivery semantics and transactions
topics.summary: At-most, at-least and exactly-once; transactional.id, initTransactions and sendOffsetsToTransaction; read_committed and the consume-transform-produce loop.
blueprint: Implement processing semantics such as exactly once / at least once

topics.title: Serializers, wire format and subjects
topics.summary: Serializers and deserializers, the magic byte and schema ID wire format, and the three subject naming strategies.

topics.title: Compatibility and schema evolution
topics.summary: BACKWARD (the default), FORWARD, FULL, NONE and the transitive variants; which changes each allows and who upgrades first; Avro defaults.

topics.title: Client security: SSL, SASL and ACLs
topics.summary: security.protocol, SSL and SASL client properties, SASL mechanisms, and ACLs at a conceptual level. RBAC is out of scope.
blueprint: Connect to a secured Apache Kafka cluster

topics.title: The Admin API
topics.summary: The Admin client: creating, describing and deleting topics, changing configs, listing and altering consumer group offsets, and the futures its calls return.
blueprint: Understand the Apache Kafka Admin API

topics.title: Deploying and scaling clients
topics.summary: bootstrap.servers and client.id, scaling consumers and Streams instances against the partition count, running clients in containers (Docker, Kubernetes) including Streams state, and clean shutdown.
blueprint: Deploy applications including KStreams for example: Docker/Kubernetes

topics.title: Streams DSL: streams, tables and repartitioning
topics.summary: KStream vs KTable vs GlobalKTable, stateless and stateful operations, what triggers repartitioning, application.id and internal topics, Processor API basics.

topics.title: Streams joins and windowing
topics.summary: Stream-stream, stream-table and table-table joins, co-partitioning, and tumbling, hopping, sliding and session windows with grace periods.

topics.title: State stores, fault tolerance and EOS
topics.summary: RocksDB state stores and changelog topics, standby replicas, and processing.guarantee=exactly_once_v2.
blueprint: Implement processing semantics such as exactly once / at least once

topics.title: Connect architecture and REST API
topics.summary: Source vs sink, standalone vs distributed workers and their internal topics, connectors and tasks, and the REST API.
blueprint: Understand Kafka Connect core concepts including sink, source, and CDC

topics.title: Converters, SMTs and error handling
topics.summary: Converters vs transforms, errors.tolerance, dead letter queue topics and error logging.

topics.title: Change data capture (CDC)
topics.summary: What CDC is, log-based vs query-based capture, how inserts, updates and deletes become keyed change events and tombstones, and why CDC topics are often compacted. Settings of specific connectors are out of scope.
blueprint: Understand Kafka Connect core concepts including sink, source, and CDC

topics.title: Testing Kafka applications
topics.summary: MockProducer and MockConsumer, TopologyTestDriver with TestInputTopic and TestOutputTopic, MockProcessorContext, a mock Schema Registry, and integration tests against a real broker.

topics.title: Client metrics and consumer lag
topics.summary: The producer, consumer, Streams and Connect metrics worth knowing, how clients expose them over JMX, and what consumer lag measures.

topics.title: Troubleshooting client applications
topics.summary: Reading common client errors and symptoms (timeouts, oversized records, NotEnoughReplicas, CommitFailedException, rebalance loops, poison-pill records) and the config or code change that fixes each.
